data.one_liner: Apply CSS-like filter effects to any Flutter widget with presets and custom matrices.
data.what_it_does: Applies various CSS filter effects like blur, contrast, grayscale, and sepia to any Flutter widget, not just images. It supports filter overlays, custom filter matrices, filter intensities, and a wide collection of Instagram-like presets.
use_when: You want to apply CSS-style image filters or color adjustments to generic Flutter widgets.
You need ready-to-use Instagram-like filter presets in your app.
avoid_when: You require complex fragment shaders or custom GPU-accelerated low-level graphics beyond standard CSS filters.
strengths: Supports multiple filter effects overlay and custom filter matrices.
Includes a large collection of built-in Instagram-like presets.
Can be applied to any widget, not just images.
weaknesses: Limited to CSS-style color matrix and blur operations.
